reasoning_input.question_text: The polynomial f(x) = x⁴ + ax² + b is divisible by x² - 1. Find the values of a and b given that f(2) = 15.

student_steps.content: Subtract equation (2) from (3): (4a + b) - (a + b) = -1 - (-1) → 3a = 0 → a = 0
Substitute a = 0 into a + b = -1: b = -1

steps.description: Identify factors (x-1) and (x+1) and set up f(1) = 0
Substitute x = 1 to get equation a + b = -1
Substitute x = 2 to get equation 4a + b = -1
Solve simultaneous system to find a = 0 and b = -1
